title: FinLLM-KG：知识图谱增强的LLM金融情感分析框架
summary: FinLLM-KG是一个模型无关框架，在推理时将金融知识图谱中来自SEC 10-K文件的公司级知识注入因果LLM，无需更新权重，即可让情感预测结合公司背景信息，并支持句子级与知识图谱事实级归因，提升可解释性，模拟显示其投资组合表现优于现有基线。
summary_en: FinLLM-KG is a model-agnostic framework that injects company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings via a financial knowledge graph into causal LLMs at inference time without weight updates, enabling context-aware sentiment prediction with sentence- and fact-level attribution for explainability; simulations show improved portfolio performance over state-of-the-art baselines.
